chunks: About the tithes taken from a man, are they counted as part of his zakat? He said: "Yes, if he wishes."

key_terms.إِنْ شَاءَ: if he wishes; indicating personal option in counting it
key_terms.الْعُشُورِ: tithes or levies taken from property or goods
key_terms.زَكَاتِهِ: his zakat, the obligatory alms-tax due from him
key_terms.يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ: Ya'qub ibn Shu'ayb, the questioner in the narration

ai.seo_question: Can tithes taken from a person be counted as part of his zakat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding whether collected tithes may be counted toward a man's zakat. The Imam عليه السلام replied affirmatively, leaving it to the person's choice.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1612 - Ya'qub ibn Shu'ayb asked him (Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)) about the tithes collected from a man: "Can they be counted as part of his Zakat?"
